title: Masala Baked Beans on Toast
intro: A snack worth the chai break. One tin of beans, one pan, 15 minutes, and it tastes nothing like the tin.

items: 1 green chilli, chopped (2 if you like it hot)
90 g cheddar, grated (about 15 g per toastie)

method: Heat the oil in a pan. Add the garlic, onion and green chilli and cook for a couple of minutes, till the onion softens. Add the capsicum for another minute.
Tip in the whole tin of beans with the oregano, chilli flakes, pepper and salt.
Let it simmer for 5 minutes, till it's properly thick. Stir the coriander through.
Put a big spoonful on each slice of bread and top with the cheese.
Bake in the oven or air fryer at 200°C for 5–6 minutes, till the cheese melts and bubbles. Finish with more coriander.
tips: Simmer till thick. Loose beans make soggy toast.
Any baked beans and any cheese work: Amul, cheddar, mozzarella, whatever's in the fridge.
The bean mix keeps 3 days in the fridge, so the next five toasties are 6 minutes away.
